[[File:Icon-Presence.png|40px]]

'''Presence''' is the icon on some [[Droid]]s and droid starfighters (introduced in [[Coruscant]]). A card with this icon has presence at its location for all purposes even though it has no ability: it may occupy and control a location, Force drain, block an opponent’s Force drain, battle, and be battled. It may not be the target of a [[Restraining Bolt]] and may not be ‘purchased’ by [[Wioslea]].

Do not confuse this with ordinary presence (total ability of 1 or more at a location).
